issues.issue: [fixed: Salaries and Wages, like Supplies on the same statement] A personnel line is put in the last-resort category 'other' although Salaries and Wages fits. The same statement's object line 'Supplies' is given the cost-type category Supplies and Materials, so the two are treated inconsistently. Holdrege_FY2024 has the same choice; if this is changed, change it there too.
Combined nonmajor column with no single function, put in 'other' (detail_category salaries and wages). Salaries and Wages would match the label.

Printed label is 'Other', so 'other' is allowed, but it is 16% of governmental receipts (more than 10%). The Statement of Activities (p2) shows Operating Grants and Contributions of 708,917 (Park 230,343, which equals the Park Fund's 'Other' cell exactly, and ARPA 478,574), so much of this line is grants. No breakdown of the line itself is printed, so it cannot be split.

issues.on_page: Community Development Fund - Operating 745,091 (Statement of Activities function 'Community development', p2)
issues.issue: The Community Betterment rule covers lines printed 'Community development/betterment'. This fund and function are 'Community development', which may belong in economic development.
The capital outlay label has no function. The General Fund maps to general government (as its Personnel/Operating detail lines do), so this would be 'Capital Outlay: General Government'.

Printed under general revenues 'Taxes' (p2). The cash-basis budget schedule (p8) shows it as State 584,593 + Highway allocation 784,297, so state aid is defensible. Noted only because the label says taxes.
